description: This file defines several simple methods related to accounting transaction services, including posting, updating, creating entries, calculating trial balances, and reversing transactions within an accounting system, specifically for the AcctgTrans and related entities.

methods.name: checkAcctgTransPosted
methods.description: Checks if an accounting transaction (AcctgTrans) has already been posted, and adds an error if it has.

methods.name: updateAcctgTransLastModified
methods.description: Updates the LastModifiedByUserLogin and timestamp of an AcctgTrans record.

methods.name: createAcctgTransEntry
methods.description: Creates a new accounting transaction entry, assigns sequence IDs, and sets default currency and amount if not provided.

methods.name: updateAcctgTransEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing AcctgTransEntry, including status, amount, and reconcile status, with checks for posted status.

methods.name: deleteAcctgTransEntry
methods.description: Removes an AcctgTransEntry and updates the associated AcctgTrans last modified info.

methods.name: calculateAcctgTransTrialBalance
methods.description: Calculates the trial balance for an AcctgTrans, summing debit and credit amounts from entries.

methods.name: postAcctgTrans
methods.description: Posts an AcctgTrans, performing validation, trial balance checks, and marking the transaction as posted.

methods.name: getAcctgTransEntriesAndTransTotal
methods.description: Retrieves and sums debit/credit amounts for an AcctgTrans and its entries, including group rollup parties.

methods.name: calculateGlAccountTrialBalance
methods.description: Calculates the trial balance for a GL account, including posted and unposted transactions.

methods.name: revertAcctgTransOnRemovePaymentApplications
methods.description: Creates reversing transactions when payment applications are removed.

methods.name: revertAcctgTransOnCancelInvoice
methods.description: Creates reversing transactions upon invoice cancellation.
